result.title: LatBridge: Efficient and Stable Model Replacement in Latent-Communication Multi-Agent Systems
result.summary: Multi-agent systems rely on communication to complete tasks, and latent communication passes continuous representations to reduce text generation and re-encoding. However, multi-agent systems must reconfigure agent models, whereas existing latent-communication methods are built for fixed model combinations, so their interfaces may fail after replacement. Our pilot study confirms this interface failure and identifies the requirement for interface reuse after model replacement. We present LatBridge, which connects agent models through a shared Bridge and separate interfaces under a shared latent-communication protocol. After agent model replacement, LatBridge reuses unchanged interfaces, selects matching low-rank interfaces, and combines them through the Bridge, training only missing ones with all models frozen. The Bridge processes source representations in the basic mode and constructs target input without autoregressive generation in the accelerated mode. Experiments support effective communication after model replacement, with mean basic-mode accuracies of 14.8% on MATH and 27.3% on ALFWorld next-action prediction across eight small-model configurations. Analyses examine the factors supporting task accuracy and communication efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文关注多智能体 latent communication 中更换智能体模型后接口失配的问题，提出 LatBridge：用一个共享 Bridge 搭配各模型独立的低秩接口形成可复用的潜在通信协议，替换模型后冻结全部模型、只训练缺失接口，并在加速模式下非自回归地由源表示构造目标输入。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨模型 latent 表示的翻译、低秩接口组合与冻结训练方式，可能为 LVR 中视觉旁路的状态注入或不同模块间潜在表示对齐提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉推理任务。
